name: skill-heaven
description: Working prototype of Skill Heaven for Claude Code, actively tested for public use. One mechanic — /summon, one skill into context for one session, nothing installed — on one line: zero · low · med · high · xhigh · max · ultra, whose four surfaces are contiguous bands read from the current rung. /skill-zero is the floor, /skill-heaven converges, /skill-hell explores, and /skill-ultra is the crown rung whose controller picks direction and depth per gap. Nothing on the line refuses. No rung carries a count and no summon is capped — what each rung reaches for is being worked out in use while the benchmark is built. Interfaces may change. The zero-default launcher and standing-dose statusline live in the claude-zero package, run from a source checkout — not part of this marketplace install.

skill_url.title: Skill URL
skill_url.description: One source URL. Use a Skill Tree website root such as https://gaiaskilltree.com or a flat GitHub repository containing SKILL.md files.

zero_cuts.title: Zero cuts (temporary/all) skills. Default is temporary.
zero_cuts.description: "temporary" (default) cuts temporary automatic summons while manual /summon remains available. "all" cuts all skill summons, including manual /summon.
